points.title: 童年成长
points.description: 约翰·列侬1940年10月9日出生于利物浦一个普通家庭，父亲阿尔弗雷德是一名商船水手，母亲朱莉亚是一位音乐爱好者。幼年时期父母离异，他被姨妈咪咪抚养长大。尽管家庭环境不稳定，但朱莉亚教会了他弹尤克里里和钢琴，培养了他对音乐的兴趣。在 Quarry Bank 中学期间，他组建了第一个乐队 The Quarrymen，1957年在教堂花园演出时结识了保罗·麦卡特尼，这成为披头士乐队诞生的起点。利物浦的工人阶级背景和战后文化氛围深刻影响了他的音乐风格和世界观。
points.descriptionEn: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool to a working-class family. His father Alfred was a merchant seaman, and his mother Julia was a music enthusiast. His parents divorced when he was young, and he was raised by his aunt Mimi. Despite the unstable family environment, Julia taught him to play the ukulele and piano, nurturing his interest in music. At Quarry Bank High School, he formed his first band, The Quarrymen. In 1957, he met Paul McCartney during a performance at a church garden, marking the beginning of The Beatles. Liverpool's working-class background and post-war cultural atmosphere profoundly influenced his musical style and worldview.

points.title: 乐队崛起
points.description: 1960年，披头士乐队在汉堡的 Indra 和 Kaiserkeller 俱乐部开始了他们的首次德国巡演，在这里他们进行了长达8小时的演出，磨练了舞台表现力和曲目储备。汉堡的经历让列侬和乐队成员形成了独特的音乐风格，并培养了他们作为专业乐队的纪律性。1962年，在利物浦的 Cavern Club 演出后，他们与 EMI 唱片公司签约，发行了首支单曲《Love Me Do》。1963年，专辑《Please Please Me》大获成功，标志着披头士现象的开始。这一时期，列侬创作了《I Want to Hold Your Hand》、《She Loves You》等经典歌曲，成为英国音乐文化的重要标志，并引领了全球的披头士热潮。
points.descriptionEn: In 1960, The Beatles began their first German tour at Hamburg's Indra and Kaiserkeller clubs, performing for up to 8 hours a night. This experience honed their stage presence and expanded their repertoire. Hamburg shaped the band's unique musical style and instilled professional discipline. After performances at Liverpool's Cavern Club in 1962, they signed with EMI Records and released their debut single 'Love Me Do.' In 1963, their album 'Please Please Me' was a massive success, marking the beginning of Beatlemania. During this period, Lennon wrote classics like 'I Want to Hold Your Hand' and 'She Loves You,' becoming a symbol of British music culture and leading to the global Beatles phenomenon.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 1966年后，随着披头士停止巡演，列侬的创作进入了一个新的阶段。在伦敦，他与小野洋子相遇，两人开始合作创作音乐和生活。这一时期，列侬创作了《Strawberry Fields Forever》、《Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds》、《I Am the Walrus》等具有实验性和哲学深度的作品。1967年的专辑《Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band》被视为摇滚乐史上的里程碑，展现了列侬作为词曲作者的成熟才华。1968年，他与小野洋子发起'床上和平运动'，抗议越南战争，这一行为引发了巨大争议。1969年，他创作并演唱了《Give Peace a Chance》，成为反战运动的圣歌。1970年，披头士正式解散，列侬开始个人音乐生涯，发行首张个人专辑《John Lennon/Plastic Ono Band》。
points.descriptionEn: After 1966, as The Beatles stopped touring, Lennon's creativity entered a new phase. In London, he met Yoko Ono, and they began collaborating musically and personally. During this period, Lennon wrote experimental and philosophically deep works like 'Strawberry Fields Forever,' 'Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds,' and 'I Am the Walrus.' The 1967 album 'Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band' is considered a milestone in rock history, showcasing Lennon's mature talent as a songwriter. In 1968, he and Yoko Ono initiated the 'Bed-In for Peace' protest against the Vietnam War, causing significant controversy. In 1969, he wrote and performed 'Give Peace a Chance,' which became an anthem for the anti-war movement. In 1970, The Beatles officially disbanded, and Lennon began his solo career with his debut album 'John Lennon/Plastic Ono Band.'

points.title: 流亡岁月
points.description: 1971年，列侬与小野洋子移居纽约市，开始了他的'流亡岁月'。这一时期，他创作了《Imagine》这张最具影响力的个人专辑，其中的同名歌曲成为和平主义的全球象征。然而，他的反战立场和批评美国政府的态度使他成为美国联邦调查局(FBI)的监视对象。1972年，他在麦迪逊广场花园举行了'反战音乐会'，并继续参与各种和平活动。1973年，他与小野洋子分居，进入所谓的'迷失周末'时期，录制了《Mind Games》和《Walls and Bridges》等专辑，其中《Whatever Gets You Through the Night》成为他唯一在美国冠军单曲。1975年，他宣布退出音乐行业，专心抚养儿子肖恩，标志着他职业生涯的一个转折点。
points.descriptionEn: In 1971, Lennon and Yoko Ono moved to New York City, beginning his 'exile years.' During this period, he created his most influential solo album, 'Imagine,' whose title song became a global symbol of pacifism. However, his anti-war stance and criticism of the US government made him a target of FBI surveillance. In 1972, he held an 'anti-war concert' at Madison Square Garden and continued to participate in various peace activities. In 1973, he separated from Yoko Ono, entering what he called his 'lost weekend' period, recording albums like 'Mind Games' and 'Walls and Bridges,' with 'Whatever Gets You Through the Night' becoming his only US number-one single. In 1975, he announced his retirement from the music industry to focus on raising his son Sean, marking a turning point in his career.

points.title: 悲剧落幕
points.description: 1980年，在隐退五年后，列侬决定重返音乐界，与妻子小野洋子合作录制了专辑《Double Fantasy》。10月，他在达科塔公寓外被一名狂热歌迷马克·大卫·查普曼枪杀，享年40岁。他的死震惊了全球，引发了大规模悼念活动。列侬的悲剧性死亡使他成为20世纪文化偶像的象征，他的音乐和和平主义理念继续影响着后世。1988年，他在纽约中央公园的草莓园(Strawberry Fields)被纪念，成为全球披头士粉丝的朝圣地。列侬的遗产超越了音乐领域，成为反战、和平与个人自由的永恒象征，他的生命虽然短暂，但对流行文化的影响却极为深远。
points.descriptionEn: In 1980, after a five-year hiatus, Lennon decided to return to music, recording the album 'Double Fantasy' with his wife Yoko Ono. On December 8, 1980, he was shot and killed by a deranged fan, Mark David Chapman, outside his apartment at the Dakota Building in New York City, at the age of 40. His death shocked the world and led to massive memorial events. Lennon's tragic death cemented his status as a symbol of 20th-century cultural icons, and his music and pacifist philosophy continue to influence later generations. In 1988, Strawberry Fields in New York's Central Park was dedicated as a memorial to him, becoming a pilgrimage site for Beatles fans worldwide. Lennon's legacy extends beyond music, becoming an eternal symbol of anti-war, peace, and personal freedom. Though his life was short, his impact on popular culture remains profoundly significant.

supporter.zh: 约翰·列侬被支持者视为20世纪最具影响力的音乐家和社会活动家之一。他的音乐创新彻底改变了流行音乐的面貌，将摇滚乐提升为艺术形式。作为披头士的核心成员，他创作了众多经典歌曲，展现了非凡的才华。他的和平主义立场和反战活动激励了整整一代人，《Imagine》成为全球和平运动的圣歌。列侬勇于挑战权威，倡导爱与和平，他的个人成长和转变过程也激励着人们追求真实自我。他的遗产超越了音乐，成为文化变革和社会进步的象征。
supporter.en: Supporters view John Lennon as one of the most influential musicians and social activists of the 20th century. His musical innovations revolutionized the face of popular music, elevating rock to an art form. As a core member of The Beatles, he created numerous classic songs, demonstrating extraordinary talent. His pacifist stance and anti-war activities inspired an entire generation, with 'Imagine' becoming an anthem for global peace movements. Lennon courageously challenged authority and advocated for love and peace, and his personal growth and transformation process inspire people to pursue their authentic selves. His legacy extends beyond music, becoming a symbol of cultural change and social progress.

critic.zh: 批评者指出列侬的言行存在明显矛盾，一方面倡导和平，另一方面却表现出暴力和愤怒倾向。他的'床上和平运动'被许多人视为作秀而非真正的政治行动。列侬在个人生活中也有争议，包括对第一任妻子辛西娅和孩子的不负责任行为，以及与小野洋子关系中表现出的控制欲。他的音乐后期被批评为过于自恋和说教，缺乏早期作品的创新性。此外，一些评论家认为他的反战立场在某种程度上是自我中心的，利用和平运动来提升个人形象而非真正关心政治变革。
critic.en: Critics point out significant contradictions in Lennon's words and actions, advocating for peace while exhibiting violent and angry tendencies. His 'Bed-In for Peace' was seen by many as a publicity stunt rather than genuine political action. Lennon's personal life was also controversial, including his irresponsible behavior towards his first wife Cynthia and their son, as well as controlling tendencies in his relationship with Yoko Ono. His later music was criticized as overly narcissistic and preachy, lacking the innovation of his earlier work. Additionally, some commentators argue that his anti-war stance was somewhat self-centered, using the peace movement to enhance his personal image rather than genuinely caring about political change.

objective.zh: 在历史学和流行文化视角下，约翰·列侬被定义为一位复杂的文化符号，反映了20世纪后半叶的社会变革。他既是音乐创新的先驱，也是反战运动的标志性人物。列侬的职业生涯展现了从流行偶像到艺术家的转变，以及从商业成功到个人追求的平衡过程。他的悲剧性死亡使他成为永恒的文化偶像，其形象在流行文化中被不断重塑和解读。历史学界认为，列侬的影响力不仅在于他的音乐成就，更在于他如何将个人艺术表达与社会政治议题结合，影响了后来的音乐人和社会活动家。他的遗产体现了艺术与政治、个人与集体之间的复杂关系。
objective.en: From a historical and popular culture perspective, John Lennon is defined as a complex cultural symbol reflecting the social changes of the latter half of the 20th century. He was both a pioneer of musical innovation and an iconic figure in the anti-war movement. Lennon's career demonstrates a transformation from pop idol to artist and a balance between commercial success and personal pursuit. His tragic death cemented his status as an eternal cultural icon, whose image continues to be reshaped and interpreted in popular culture. Historians believe that Lennon's influence lies not only in his musical achievements but also in how he combined personal artistic expression with social and political issues, influencing later musicians and activists. His legacy embodies the complex relationship between art and politics, and the individual and collective.

self.zh: 生活就是当你忙于制定其他计划时发生的事情。
self.en: Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.

others.zh: 列侬是披头士的灵魂，是那个时代的声音，是那个时代的诗人。
others.en: Lennon was the soul of the Beatles, the voice of the era, the poet of the age.
